rules.name: FRAGMENTS OF SHATTERED TIME
rules.text: Each [Presence] on this ability represents 1 Time. Many of your Powers require Time as an additional cost. Spend it when you Resolve the Power. (Not when you play it.) When you Gain 1 Time , put 1 of your [Presence] here from your [Presence] track (or, optionally, the island). When you Spend 1 Time , return it to a [Presence] track - or if you have no free spaces, Destroy it.
rules.turn:
#acc time : spirit @sum
spirit:special S fragments / time S 0
presence-of S P, at P (time-panel S) / time S 1
gain-time S
  ?[rng] P
  !(presence-of S P, at P (track S))
  ~time-from S P
gain-time-from-island S
  ?[rng] P
  !(presence-of S P, at P L, land L)
  ~time-from S P
time-from S C, is C P, ~move P (time-panel S)
spend-time S N, gt N 0
  ?[rng] P
  !(presence-of S P, at P (time-panel S))
  ~>spend-one S P
  minus N 1 N1
  ~spend-time S N1
spend-one S C, is C P, track-free S F, gt F 0, ~move P (track S)
spend-one S C, is C P, track-free S 0, ~move P destroyed
use-power S P, power:time-cost P N, ~spend-time S N
fast-phase, played S P, power:time-cost P N, time S T, lt T N, { use-power S P => ^unaffordable S P }
slow-phase, played S P, power:time-cost P N, time S T, lt T N, { use-power S P => ^unaffordable S P }
rules.evidence: gain 2 Time (f1 from track, f2 from island); slip (cost 1) resolves and returns 1 Time to the 1-space track; rewind (cost 1) finds no free space and destroys it; eon (cost 3) -> unaffordable fractured eon.
rules.notes: Time is just Presence at a location (time-panel S), counted by an @sum: the 'resource' is board state, as on the physical panel. Paying at resolve is a trigger on use-power; the 'cannot afford' gate is an exception over core's phase rule. 'or, optionally, the island' is modeled as a second gain episode rather than one combined choice.

rules.name: DAYS THAT NEVER WERE
rules.text: Your 3rd Growth option lets you gain any one Power Card from a special set you create during Setup. When you gain a Power Card any other way, you may add one unchosen card to this set.
rules.turn:
growth-3 S
  ?[rng] C
  !(days-set S C)
  ~days-gain S C
days-gain S C, is C K, +owns S K, ^left-days-set S K
kept S G C, spirit:special S days, is C K
  ?[rng] U
  !(drawn G U, neq U K)
  ~days-add S U
days-add S C, is C U, +days-set S U
rules.evidence: draw1 keeps card-d, days-add puts unchosen card-c in the set, growth-3 then gains card-c.
rules.notes: 'any other way' is free: the trigger names the draw episode, not growth-3. Missing: removing a card from the set when it is gained (a growing relation can't shrink; would need location-style state like Time), and real decks/Growth options.

base_ext: Presence track as a location with a space count (track-free); gain-power-draw over a fixed `drawn` set; growth-3 option.
language_issues: Sets that lose members (the Days set) can't be plain relations; anything removable must be modeled as a piece with an `at` location.
Choosing 'any card except the kept one' needs a JS `neq` over JSON-encoded terms.
